features: bi-spectrum thermal + visible bullet camera, longer-lens variant of A371
thermal sensor: 256x192, NETD <40mK at F1.0, fixed focal 6.9mm F1.0, 24.9 deg HOV / 18.7 deg VOV

built-in analytics: people/vehicle detection, smart intrusion protection (line crossing/intrusion/enter/exit area for people and vehicle), tampering, temperature detection, smoking detection, fire detection, sun-reflection filter
radiometric temperature measurement: point/area/line, up to 21 rules, range -20 to 150C, accuracy +/-8C
detection range: people 287m, vehicle 881m; triggering analytics notification: people 55.2m, vehicle 144.9m; fire detection 82.8m; smoking detection 10.35m
1x RS-485 serial port, 1x BNC analog video output (installation only), 2/2 digital input/output
2-way audio via mic-in/line-in/line-out (external jacks, no built-in mic/speaker)
IK10 vandal-proof metal casing, real-time clock
